name: Своя мастерская
approval_context: E1 now uses eleven atomic sheet-parts in the same four-role structure as the complete E0 candidate. After five rejected attempts, the former combined 8-specimen materials-construction/01-surfaces-stock sheet was removed from the canonical plan and split into two guarded 4-specimen sheet-parts to prevent repeated specimen collapse. No E1 sheet is approved yet.

preserved: olive/gray utilitarian ancestry with practical work lighting
replaced: ad-hoc hand-built construction with standardized industrial modules
open improvised cable runs with trays, harnesses and organized pipe racks
primarily manual mechanisms with hydraulics and electromechanical drives
individually fitted controls with grouped repeatable operator modules
isolated ad-hoc lamps with planned standardized lighting and signal families
added: standardized cabinets, service covers, brackets and connectors
hydraulic and electromechanical drive components with guards
monochrome and limited early color CRT hardware where functionally justified
industrial safety color coding and repeatable utility routing
transition_from_e0.why: The base has matured from a garage prototype into a standardized workshop with repeatable production, maintenance and operating procedures.
transition_from_e0.player_signal: More ordered construction, repeated module language, guarded assisted mechanisms, safety coding, organized utilities and denser but still period-appropriate controls.

usage.reference_strategy: Generate the eleven planned E1 atomic sheet-parts from their machine-readable guarded specs/prompts. Begin with 01a-flat-materials, then 01b-profiles-polymers. The five rejected combined-sheet attempts are provenance only and must not be used as visual evidence. Use the complete exact-SHA E0 candidate set only as lineage/comparison evidence for E0↔E1 cross-era review; do not use previous broad E1 reference boards.
usage.system_separation: Physical hardware/materials belong in art; dynamic glow, active screens/data, motion, sparks, fields and temporary FX remain code-owned unless explicitly scoped otherwise.
